# prime-dataview

prime-rs: DataView component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/dataview) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-dataview) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/dataview.md)

DataView - port of `p-dataview` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Data as a list or a grid with a paginator, sorting and a filter. The application defines how items look
(`list` and `grid` receive the items of the current page), the filter is a predicate, sorting is a comparison and an order.
The selection and page logic is the pure `data`.

```rust
#![recursion_limit = "512"]
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_dataview::DataView;

let items = vec!["Apple".to_owned(), "Pear".to_owned()];
let list = Callback::new(|page: Vec<String>| view! { <ul>{page.into_iter().map(|i| view! { <li>{i}</li> }).collect_view()}</ul> }.into_any());
let html = view! { <DataView value=items list=list /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-dataview-list") && html.contains("<li>Apple</li>"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-dataview = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["dataview"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
